description: Pedestrian Count (Hourly) is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Casey. Displays the Hourly pedestrian count automatically recorded by IoT sensors since 12th Aug 2021, which are installed at few locations in City of Casey. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Sensor IoT, Community Build App - Public Artwork Discovery. Its keywords are pedestrian count, IoT, Sensor. The portal shows 52,516 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
